description: Settles disputed match results; the players are told. "resolve" sets the winner of a played match and moves its ELO board at once; a decided match cannot be resolved again; "annul" takes a match out of the counts (ELO recounted); "declareCheater" gives their open disputes to the other side and flags them, blocked from reporting or banned as results.cheater says; "clearCheater" lifts it, settled matches stay. Queue: neblla_matches_read; a rating by hand: neblla_scores. More: neblla_get_llms tools/matches

action.description: What to do. By action: resolve {match, winner: "A" | "B" | "draw", note?}; annul {match, note?}

appId.description: The app's public ID, from neblla_list_apps.

env.description: "pro" (the published app, what users have) or "pre" (the private test copy); left out: the environment the developer picked for this app in the panel.

match.description: resolve / annul: the match (its session's or room's id).

user.description: declareCheater / clearCheater: the user's id in the app.
